hosts.statement: vantage.insta.host is served publicly with no identity gate, unchanged from 2.1.0. Every SPA client route, content-hashed static asset, health/readiness endpoint, and the public trust/config APIs answer 200 to an anonymous request, while every authenticated API path answers 401. 2.2.0 adds only a pre-login/signup marketing landing page rendered client-side at '/' for unauthenticated visitors; the public edge topology, DNS, certificate, and API surface are otherwise unchanged.
